capabilities: Search the vault semantically with passages linked back to their notes
Chat with the vault or current note via a RAG panel with [1]-style citations
Index new, edited, renamed, and deleted notes automatically
Run chat and embedding models locally through llama.cpp with no cloud calls
extras: Desktop only (no mobile); first run downloads ~3 GB of models and runtime; Intel Macs unsupported; uninstalling requires a two-step process because the backend lives outside the vault.
motivation: The author built it for privacy: all AI runs on local models so notes never leave the computer, with no account or API keys.
problem: Obsidian's built-in search is keyword-based, and most AI assistant plugins send notes to cloud APIs, which conflicts with keeping notes private.

relations.evidence: Khora is a pure-Python library, so the plugin drives it through a small local sidecar.
All the AI runs on local models through llama.cpp

summary: Local-AI plugin that indexes your vault for semantic search and runs an offline RAG chat that answers with citations to your notes.
